decision_scope: Rank one concrete next cold-start implementation experiment while the independent review of RUN-KIC-e3dbed is pending. This file does not create an experiment record, approve execution, allocate identifiers, or change any hypothesis, goal, lane, or claim status.

source_observation.implementation_detail: The existing allocation uses expected.next_power_of_two with no explicit load-factor headroom.

evidence.current_result_context: RUN-KIC-e3dbed selected K=75 but its held-out direct/rho whole-process comparison was a finite non-confirmation. The original run and all its 96 valid records remain unchanged and require their independent review.
evidence.limited_search: A limited internal search of the Stage99 scripts and GATE_STATUS found no eta=1/384, load-factor, or capacity experiment. The search scope is insufficient for a novelty, known-work, or completeness conclusion.

candidate.title: Double only the active signed-expanded K=75 hash-slot capacity under the common ARM implementation
candidate.one_factor_change: For K=75 and eta=1/256 only, double the active signed-expanded hash-slot capacity from 16777216 to 33554432 while preserving the same Bloom allocation, insertion domain, witness policy, mathematical construction, ARM field backend, thread count, cold-start process boundary, and CLI/dataflow.
candidate.mechanism: At 94.10799% measured occupancy, open-addressing linear probes may contribute avoidable cold setup/query cost. Doubling slots reduces the realized occupancy for the same 15788701-entry table without changing the relation/factor-base mathematical instance.

expected_benefit.prediction: If high-load probing is material, the new-capacity direct arm should show shorter direct setup and/or query stages than the old-capacity direct arm on fresh matched targets, while preserving the same correctness certificates.
not_predicted: a lower bound on future direct cost

memory_cost.known_effect: The active signed-expanded table reserves twice as many slots; the Bloom allocation is unchanged.
memory_cost.unknown_effect: Exact byte delta, peak RSS delta, allocator overhead, and interaction with cold wall time are not inferred from slot count. They must be separately measured and reported for each arm.

alternative_considered.reason_not_ranked_first: Changing eta/K and load at once confounds factor-base density with hash occupancy, so it cannot isolate whether the specific 94% load observation is causal.

ahead_of_doing_nothing.rationale: This is a narrowly localized, semantics-preserving, one-factor test of a directly measured high-occupancy implementation condition. It can falsify the capacity mechanism with a complete-system fresh-target control, and its memory cost is explicit rather than hidden.
ahead_of_doing_nothing.qualification: It ranks ahead of doing nothing only if the pending independent review validates RUN-KIC-e3dbed's source closure, cold-boundary accounting, and raw records. A review finding that invalidates those inputs removes this ranking basis.

ranking.dispatch_status: not eligible until a fresh protocol, Coordinator approval, source closure, and review-validity readback exist

bounded_protocol_outline.scope: Design outline only; values below are proposed for a later frozen protocol and are not authorization to run.
arms: old_capacity_direct: common-ARM K=75 eta=1/256 configuration with 16777216 active signed-expanded slots
new_capacity_direct: identical common-ARM K=75 eta=1/256 configuration with 33554432 active signed-expanded slots
matched_rho: the same common-ARM one-thread rho baseline used without weakening or changing rho
bounded_protocol_outline.proposed_cases: 24 fresh public-synthetic explicit-scalar known-answer targets, disjoint from every RUN-KIC-e3dbed calibration and held-out scalar.
bounded_protocol_outline.proposed_order_control: Use each of the six permutations of old-capacity direct, new-capacity direct, and rho exactly four times across the 24 target blocks. Each target receives exactly one process from each arm, with serial fresh-process execution and no retries.
primary_future_comparisons: new-capacity direct versus old-capacity direct on matched fresh targets
each direct capacity arm versus matched rho, reported separately
required_correctness_controls: Before timing, show old/new capacity variants have identical target construction, base fingerprint, accepted-relation digest, sparse-row/rank fields, recovered scalar, group equation, and result digest on predeclared untimed known-answer controls.
Bind exact source diffs and binaries; reject any change outside the slot-capacity expression and mechanically required receipt reporting.
Run the same common ARM PMULL correctness/admission controls and report the actual backend for all arms.
Record complete per-process whole wall, stage times, CPU, and RSS with the same Darwin accounting boundary; report memory as a first-class outcome rather than treating capacity as free.
rejection_controls: No old RUN-KIC-e3dbed target, calibration observation, timing receipt, or selection result may be reused to select parameters or populate the future comparison.
No extra density, capacity, allocator, Bloom, witness, thread, ARM backend, or rho parameter variation is permitted in the successor run.
Any source/receipt/correctness/cold-state failure is preserved and invalidates the affected comparison; it is not mathematical negative evidence and cannot be retried as a scientific child.
A direct speed observation without separately reported RSS cost is incomplete and cannot support a memory-neutral claim.
bounded_protocol_outline.stopping_and_scope: The later protocol must freeze resource limits, watchdog, artifact paths, metrics, analysis, and independent-review plan before dispatch. It may make only a finite public-synthetic implementation observation; it cannot claim an asymptotic, SOTA, security, or cryptanalytic improvement.
